notes.notes: Fixed an issue that prevents players from some countries from entering the game

notes.title: 0.2.0 Update - bug fixes / online networking optimization and more!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support of Mikrocosmos! Since the release of Early Access, we have collected a bunch of bugs from playtesters and fixed them accordingly. The followings are the detailed update notes of 0.2.0:

Online experience optimization
During our playtesting in the past week, we found that some players (especially those in mainland China) are prone to large-scale delays and even pop-ups when playing online games. To this end, we implemented Spatial Hashing Interest Management in the new version to greatly reduce the data traffic during the game, so as to reduce the network delay when the Steam backend connection is not stable.


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug that a small number of entities could not display their descriptions
 Fixed physics issues with deployed mines
 Fixed a localization problem in the Tutorial.
 Fixed a bug where some mini-game rewards were displayed incorrectly in localization
 Fixed a problem that the localized description of some buff effects displayed incorrectly
 Update the title of the game in the main menu
 Updated Special Thanks List
